appPage.metaDescription: Avant Regard is an Archive app for true fashion enthusiasts: 400+ global boutique maps, 200+ designers & 9000+ show archives, professional Archivist community. Free on iOS.
appPage.metaOgDescription: Discover Archive · Connect Boutiques · Mobile Fashion Archives. Free on iOS.
appPage.tagline: Discover Archive · Connect Boutiques · Mobile Fashion Archives
appPage.heroBody: Avant Regard Archive is the premier Archive platform for true fashion enthusiasts. We don't chase trends — we collect eras.
appPage.featuresHeading:
Four things that give you
complete access to Archive.
appPage.feature01Body: Professional Archive boutiques covering major cities globally — from Paris, London, Tokyo to New York, from hidden spaces to legendary stores. Every store is curated: only genuine Archive professionals make the cut.
appPage.feature02Body: From classic masters to avant-garde movements, from golden eras to contemporary iconic collections. Complete designer career timelines, show looks, collection stories and design language.
appPage.feature03Body: Post authentic reviews and experiences about pieces, boutiques and show collections. Exchange views, share collections, authenticate styles and discuss outfits with Archivists worldwide.
appPage.feature04Body: Archive isn't vintage or secondhand — it's fashion history's wearable heritage. We organize movements, eras, iconic designs, fabric craftsmanship and collecting logic for you.
appPage.audienceHeading:
If this sounds like you,
this app was made for you.
appPage.audience4: Those building refined aesthetics and style systems
appPage.audienceFooter: Join Avantregard Archive, become a true Archivist, and own your gateway to fashion history.
appPage.whatsNewHeading:
Chat system live,
experience fully upgraded.
appPage.whatsNew1Body: Stranger-to-stranger chat, add chat friends, one-tap share Archive posts — social and content sharing seamlessly connected.
appPage.whatsNew2Body: More refined visuals, smoother native performance, overall interaction quality elevated.
appPage.whatsNew3Body: Outstanding creators earn exclusive honor titles, recognizing creative value and encouraging sustained quality content.
appPage.whatsNew4Body: More timely notifications, more accurate delivery — never miss important interactions or system messages.
appPage.whatsNew5Body: Comprehensive data and feature update: more complete info, more precise locations, smoother browsing.

to fashion history.
